headline: Protect and grow your money, with Neil in your corner: a small-group mentorship for people who want more than a course.

headline.before: I built the call funnel for your

bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 17,000 students. None of them can work with you directly.
beats.text: Your channel has 560,000 subscribers, your power-outage video passed 200,000 views in four days, and 17,000+ students have bought your courses. But everything you sell is self-paced, and there's no way to get you in their corner.

beats.title: Your quiz already asks the right question.
beats.text: “How are you doing financially?” sorts people by stage, and the Financial Survival Guide brings new ones in. Those are people telling you exactly where they are and what worries them.

beats.title: Every path ends at a course checkout.
beats.text: Whatever someone answers in the quiz, the next step is another course. The students who would pay most for personal guidance, the ones with a pension to protect or a business to build, get the same self-paced option as everyone else.

stats.label: ways to work with you live

beats.title: “Courses scale, calls don't.” Only a few need a call.
beats.text: The courses stay exactly as they are. The application filters out everyone else, so the calls are only with the small share who want more than a course, and a small-group mentorship needs no new content, just your time.
beats.quote: “I help you to PROTECT and GROW your finances (in a world that's designed to work against you).”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You watch the news and worry
cards.body: Energy, inflation, pensions. You know what's coming, not what to do about it.

cards.title: You've done the courses
cards.body: You know a lot more than before, and you still haven't acted on most of it.

cards.title: Your plan lives in your head
cards.body: Savings here, a pension there, an idea for extra income. Nothing written down.

mechanism.title: Protect first. Then grow.
mechanism.body: A world that works against you needs a plan in the right order: secure what you have, cut what's leaking, build income you control, then grow it. In the mentorship you build that plan over twelve weeks, with Neil and a small group.

pillars.title: Protect
pillars.body: Emergency reserves, insurance gaps and what to do if things go wrong.

pillars.title: Cut
pillars.body: Find the costs and fees that quietly drain your money.

pillars.title: Income
pillars.body: Build an extra income stream you control.

pillars.title: Grow
pillars.body: A long-term plan for pensions and investments.

items.title: 12-week programme
items.body: One step each week, with clear actions.

items.title: Live sessions with Neil
items.body: Group calls to work through your plan and questions.

items.title: All Academy courses
items.body: Full access to the Finance & Success Academy.

items.title: Small group
items.body: Members working through the same steps together.

items.title: Quarterly check-in
items.body: Review your plan after the programme.

proof.title: Students
proof.note: Individual experiences vary. Capital at risk: the value of investments can go down as well as up.

steps.title: Book a call
steps.body: If it looks like a fit, pick a time to talk with Neil's team.

steps.title: Decide on the call
steps.body: We look at where you are and whether it makes sense. The investment is explained on the call. No pressure either way.

questions.q: Have you taken any of Neil's courses?
What worries you most about your finances right now?
What would you most like to have in place 12 months from now?
Can you give it about an hour a week for 12 weeks?
Do you understand that investing involves risk and you may get back less than you put in?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the mentorship now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the mentorship isn't the right next step for you. Start with the free Financial Survival Guide and Neil's videos, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to have Neil in your corner?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Educational content only. Nothing here is personalised financial advice. Capital at risk: the value of investments can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invest. Results vary from person to person.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your savings, pension and monthly costs.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Neil

preCallEmails.subject: Protect first, then grow
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people do it the other way round: chase growth, then get caught out when something goes wrong.

The mentorship starts with protecting what you have, then builds from there.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Neil

preCallEmails.subject: "I've already done the courses"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you've got the knowledge.

The mentorship is for putting it into action: twelve weeks, live sessions and a written plan, with me and a small group.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Neil

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Neil

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Neil's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Neil

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Neil
